text.brief: In April 2010 two intelligence officers of the People's Republic approached the former CIA officer Jerry Chun Shing Lee and offered him $100,000 in cash.
text.record: Lee had left the agency in 2007, and in August 2012 FBI agents found notebooks in his Honolulu hotel room with the true names of CIA assets and their meeting places ([Criminal complaint affidavit, United States v. Jerry Chun Shing Lee, No. 1:18-mj-18 (E.D. Va.; DOJ copy)](https://www.justice.gov/opa/press-release/file/1026646/dl)). Between 2010 and 2012 the Party's security services killed or imprisoned as many as twenty CIA sources on the mainland, according to reporting in 2017 ([NPR, May 21, 2017: efforts in China to dismantle CIA operations (interview with Mark Mazzetti of the New York Times; media only)](https://www.npr.org/transcripts/529419491); [TheJournal.ie, May 22, 2017: China killed or jailed up to 20 US spies in two years (media only)](https://www.thejournal.ie/article.php?id=3402151)). The FBI arrested Lee in January 2018 ([Criminal complaint affidavit, United States v. Jerry Chun Shing Lee (filed January 13, 2018)](https://www.justice.gov/opa/press-release/file/1026646/dl)). He pleaded guilty to conspiracy to deliver national defense information and received 19 years in November 2019 ([NBC News: Former CIA officer sentenced to 19 years for conspiring with Chinese spies (November 2019; media only)](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/former-cia-officer-sentenced-19-years-conspiring-chinese-spies-n1089341); [KPBS/NPR: Ex-CIA officer sentenced to 19 years for conspiracy to spy for China (November 22, 2019; media only)](https://kpbs.org/news/2019/11/22/ex-cia-officer-sentenced-to-19-years-for)).
text.reading: The public record does not settle whether Lee, a compromised communications system or both gave the Party the names. A network that depends on one channel or one officer's memory fails all at once, which is Criticality at its most lethal. The Party shut the door and took everyone inside, which is Stratagem 22.
text.gapText: Data Architecture. A departing officer carried source names in notebooks, and no control stopped the record from leaving with him.
text.fix: Treat source identities as data that never leaves a controlled system, and compartment networks so one breach cannot expose them all.
